stories.headline: Two American economists share the Nobel prize in economic sciences
stories.summary: Robert Hall and Michael Woodford have jointly won this year’s Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences. They were honoured for work on how the choices of households and firms underpin attempts to steady a whole economy. Hall is a professor at Stanford University and Woodford teaches at Columbia University.

stories.headline: Ülle Madise is sworn in as Estonia’s seventh president
stories.summary: Ülle Madise, a jurist who had been Estonia’s Chancellor of Justice since 2015, was sworn in as president on 12 October. The Riigikogu, the country’s parliament, had elected her on 2 September. She succeeds Alar Karis, who served one term and chose not to stand again.

stories.headline: Perseverance drives farther than any vehicle on another world
stories.summary: NASA’s Perseverance rover has now driven farther than any vehicle has on the surface of another world. It reached the mark after five and a half years on Mars, over ground that took the earlier Opportunity rover almost fifteen years to cover. Most of that distance was driven with the rover choosing its own course.
